meta.title: Quick Restart
meta.description: Adds a Restart item to the account menu, with one confirmation step.

dialog.title: Restart DeepSeek Harness?
dialog.body: The app will close and start again automatically. Anything still generating and any running terminal task will be interrupted.
dialog.note: This usually takes 3–10 seconds; this page comes back automatically.
dialog.runningBody: The app is about to close. Do not close the window yourself; this page will come back automatically.
dialog.openLogHint: If this keeps failing, send the log file above to the developer.

toast.hostMissing: Restart service is not loaded (host plugin inactive). Restart the app once, then try again.

reason.notDesktop: Running in dsh web mode: the process is not hosted by the desktop app, so it cannot restart itself. Use the desktop app or restart it from a terminal.
reason.noElectron: No Electron main process detected; desktop restart is unavailable.
reason.noHelper: Plugin is incomplete: restart-helper.cjs is missing.
reason.inProgress: A restart is already in progress. Please wait.
reason.unauthorized: The connection failed the sign-in/origin check (HTTP {status}).
reason.forbidden: Request origin is not trusted (HTTP {status}). Open the page from the app and retry.
reason.network: Cannot reach the restart service; the host may not have loaded this plugin.
reason.timeout: The app did not exit in time; the restart may have been blocked.
